name: Fascia, 4,800 × 900 mm (street front)
how: Black aluminium composite panel (3 mm ACM). The frame is 40 mm Sunset LED neon flex; the Mark and lettering are built-up channel letters, 50 mm deep, Sunset acrylic faces, face-lit (warm white LEDs behind Sunset acrylic). Lit dusk to 22:00 on a timer.

name: Fascia, 2,400 × 600 mm (mall bulkhead, narrow fronts)
how: Black ACM panel. Frame, Mark and lettering in 10 mm flat-cut Sunset acrylic, pinned 20 mm off the panel and halo-lit (white LEDs behind). Check the centre's signage criteria first.

name: Projecting blade sign, Ø600 mm (double-sided)
how: Round double-sided lightbox, 120 mm deep, black powder-coated, on a wall bracket at least 2,400 mm above the pavement. Faces: black-printed opal acrylic with the artwork left clear so it glows Sunset (or Sunset vinyl on opal). Same artwork both sides.

name: Window poster, 1,000 × 1,250 mm
how: Printed on the back of clear window film (or on a black foamboard panel hung 50 mm behind the glass). The window-poster frame: our oldest brand code, the store window itself.

name: Door vinyl (sample hours)
how: Cut Sunset vinyl, applied to the outside of the door glass at eye level (centre 1,500 mm from the floor). One colour, no background.
